applyTo: "03_makoha-butterfly-corpus/**"

Files under this path are the Mākoha research corpus, its MANIFEST and its published pages. They are verbatim, zero edits permitted (00_MANIFEST §1; the 03_ MANIFEST precedence law). Any pull request that changes a byte here is CRITICAL. Findings about these files are addressed to the corpus owner as proposed successor files or annexes; agents never author them. The Confluence mirror renders these files live; no page edits are needed for content changes.
